claim: Works offline after the first visit, including saving records and attachments.
where: home first screen, offline banner, empty state, README
sandbox: fresh demo browser; wait for service-worker control, go offline, save a note and receipt, reload offline, and assert both remain

sandbox: seed a real IndexedDB record, enter demo, assert it is hidden, leave demo, and assert the real record is intact

claim: The latest completed work sets the next due date.
sandbox: demo record; add a later completed-work entry and assert the displayed due date and history count

sandbox: fresh demo; filter one sample by text and schedule, force no results, clear filters, and recover all cards

claim: Records stay on this device unless exported, with no analytics, ads, trackers, or third-party runtime scripts.
sandbox: capture every request through a demo workflow and assert only the product origin plus the isolated demo database

claim: Open JSON exports contain every note and attachment.
sandbox: download the fresh demo archive and assert all three records, a known note, and both named attachments

claim: Print one-page history prepares the selected card and its full history.
sandbox: fresh demo; invoke print and assert exactly one print target with expanded history

where: home first screen, paid section, data dialog, terms, README
sandbox: fresh demo seeded to eight cards; assert the free block and exact offer, then use a cached valid license and save a ninth card

sandbox: fresh licensed demo; inspect the encrypted download, delete a card, import it, and assert its named attachment returns

claim: A saved license is verified at most once per day.
sandbox: fresh demo with a current cached verdict; intercept verification and assert zero network calls

claim: Each attachment can be up to 10 MB.
sandbox: fresh demo; save a 10 MiB photo, then submit a 10 MiB plus one byte receipt and assert rejection without closing the form

claim: Encrypted archives require a passphrase of at least 10 characters.
sandbox: fresh licensed demo; assert 9 characters fail and 10 characters produce an encrypted download

claim: Archive passphrases are not sent or stored and cannot be recovered.
sandbox: fresh licensed demo; export with a unique passphrase, assert no request, reload, and inspect browser storage and the empty input

claim: Invalid or unreadable imports leave current records unchanged.
sandbox: fresh demo; import an incomplete branded archive and assert no confirmation and all three cards survive reload

claim: A card can be deleted after confirmation.
sandbox: fresh demo; cancel deletion once, confirm it once, reload, and assert only the chosen card stays deleted

claim: A saved license can be removed without changing maintenance cards.
sandbox: fresh licensed demo; remove the license, inspect both license keys, reload, and assert the cards remain with the free state
